stories.title: Attackers Exploit Zimbra Flaw to Deploy Web Shells and Harvest Authentication Secrets
stories.description: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-73570 in Zimbra to deploy web shells and access mailbox data on servers with SNMP notifications enabled.

stories.title: Attackers Abuse MSP360 to Deploy ScreenConnect in Dual-RMM Phishing Attacks
stories.description: Microsoft says phishing attacks abuse MSP360 and ScreenConnect to maintain redundant remote access on compromised Windows endpoints.

stories.title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-76504 to access Cisco SD-WAN Manager APIs as admin without credentials; fixed releases are available.

stories.title: Attackers Abuse ChatGPT Custom GPTs to Deliver RAT via ClickFix Lures
stories.description: Attackers abuse ChatGPT Custom GPTs and ClickFix lures to deliver a RAT, infecting at least 40 users.

stories.title: Google: AI Is Changing the Pace and Profile of Vulnerability Discovery
stories.description: Google’s analysis found that AI-discovered vulnerabilities are more likely to enable remote code execution.

stories.title: WatchGuard Patches Critical Fireware OS Code Injection Vulnerability
stories.description: WatchGuard has rolled out patches for 15 code execution, DoS, authorization, and path traversal bugs in Fireware OS.

stories.title: Government, Finance Orgs Targeted in Weeks-Long NetScaler Zero-Day Attacks
stories.description: Several security firms have confirmed seeing exploitation of the NetScaler vulnerabilities CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772.

stories.title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch Over 100 Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Some of the flaws could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or escape the browser sandbox.
